# laravelforge_provider_size (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge provider size (server plan) by ID. Sizes are scoped to a server provider (e.g. DigitalOcean, AWS), not to an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Forge ID of the provider size.
- `provider_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server provider that offers the size (Forge API `provider` path segment; `provider` is reserved in HCL).

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture.
- `category` (String) Category name of the size.
- `code` (String) Code identifier from the provider.
- `cpus` (Number) Number of CPUs.
- `disk` (Number) Amount of disk space in MB.
- `disk_type` (String) Type of disk.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the size.
- `ram` (Number) Amount of RAM in MB.
- `series` (String) Series type of the size.
